description: This is a C source file implementing a firmware tool for appending and extracting signatures and metadata from firmware images, including command-line argument parsing, file handling, CRC calculations, and data processing.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the firmware tool.

methods.name: open_file
methods.description: Opens a file for reading or writing based on the mode.

methods.name: set_file
methods.description: Sets up a file for appending or extracting, ensuring mode consistency.

methods.name: trailer_update_crc
methods.description: Updates the CRC32 checksum in a trailer structure.

methods.name: append_data
methods.description: Appends data from an input file to an output file with CRC updates.

methods.name: append_trailer
methods.description: Writes a trailer structure to a file with CRC calculation.

methods.name: add_metadata
methods.description: Adds metadata to the firmware image.

methods.name: add_signature
methods.description: Adds a signature to the firmware image.

methods.name: add_data
methods.description: Main function to add metadata or signature to firmware file.

methods.name: extract_data
methods.description: Extracts data (metadata or signature) from firmware image.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Closes open files and cleans up resources.
